const API_BASE=typeof window!=="undefined"&&window.location&&window.location.port==="3000"?"http://localhost:8000/api":"/api";export async function generateAssessment(course){const res=await fetch("".concat(API_BASE,"/assessment/generate"),{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({course})});return res.json();}export async function checkAssessment(course,answers,questions){const res=await fetch("".concat(API_BASE,"/assessment/check"),{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({course,answers,questions})});return res.json();}export async function checkSimilarity(course,file){const formData=new FormData();formData.append("course",course);formData.append("file",file);const res=await fetch("".concat(API_BASE,"/similarity/check"),{method:"POST",body:formData});return res.json();}
